backend/main.mo: Motoko canister implementing blob storage mixin, access control, user profiles, and trending media management with admin-restricted updates.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report linking removal of overlay scroll buttons to FeaturedRow and listing related components and tests.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-style text mapping frontend file paths to their design and functionality summaries.
frontend/.env.example: Environment variable template showing optional TMDB API key configuration.
frontend/.gitignore: Gitignore rules for logs, build outputs, editor files, and environment files.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML entry point mounting React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main app component managing media selection modal, authentication state, profile setup, and global query settings.
frontend/src/components/AddShowDialog.ts: Dialog component for searching TV shows and adding them to a tracked list with error handling and identity checks.
Banner displaying TMDB API health warnings and fallback API key notice.
frontend/src/components/ContentGrid.tsx: Grid component fetching and displaying trending content with loading, error, and empty states.
frontend/src/components/FeaturedRow.tsx: Fetches and displays featured media in a horizontally scrollable row with loading and error states.
frontend/src/components/FilterBar.tsx: Provides dropdown controls for filtering media type and sorting options, with an optional badge indicator.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Renders the site footer with credits, links, and branding.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Displays app header with branding and authentication controls using Internet Identity.
frontend/src/components/Hero.tsx: Shows a hero banner with background image and introductory text.
frontend/src/components/MediaCard.tsx: Renders a media item card with poster, metadata, trailer action, and TV show tracking support.
frontend/src/components/NetflixTop10.tsx: Loads and displays the top 10 trending items with ranking badges and MediaCard components.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupDial: Modal dialog for entering and saving a new user profile name.
frontend/src/components/TrackedShows.tsx: Shows the user’s tracked TV shows with loading, error handling, and remove functionality.
frontend/src/components/TrailerModal.tsx: Modal component that fetches and displays a trailer for a selected media item, handling loading, errors, and iframe lifecycle.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to the current Internet Identity, invalidating dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides context and hooks for Internet Identity login, logout, and identity restoration using Dfinity AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for TMDB API data, trailer fetching with error types, API health checks, and user-related backend operations.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind-based global styles defining light/dark themes, animated gradient backgrounds, and custom scrollbars.
frontend/src/lib/devDiagnostics.ts: Development-only logging utilities for trailer fetching, modal events, and iframe lifecycle diagnostics.
frontend/src/main.tsx: App entry point initializing React Query and Internet Identity providers and rendering the root App component.
frontend/src/vite-env.d.ts: Type declarations for Vite environment variables, including the TMDB API key.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration enabling dark mode, custom OKLCH-based theme colors, extended animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: JSON describing the project's versioned state, including a detailed summary of the CineStream architecture, notes, and known issues across frontend and backend components.
